subject: chemistry
user_instruction: 받는 용기만 오른쪽으로 더 멀리 옮기고, 전달관을 그 위치까지 연장한다. 나머지 장치의 구조와 배치는 유지하여 평가원식 흑백 선화로 정리한다.
source_inventory: one round distillation flask containing one liquid region
one neck stopper block and one plain thermometer stem
one delivery tube from the flask neck toward the receiver
one open receiver containing one collected-liquid region
one rectangular heater below the flask

operations.target: the single receiver and its contained collected-liquid region
operations.change: move them horizontally right by about one receiver-neck width without resizing

operations.target: the existing delivery tube endpoint and moved receiver opening
operations.change: extend the existing tube horizontally to retain the same endpoint alignment above the open receiver; do not add a second tube
remove annotations and color and use black line art with flat gray only for the two liquid regions

locked_invariants: flask, neck block, thermometer, liquid, and heater positions and proportions remain unchanged
receiver shape, opening, neck width, and collected-liquid amount remain unchanged
delivery tube still begins at the same flask-neck point and has one continuous unbranched path
the receiver remains visibly open and separate from the delivery tube with a white gap
heater remains directly below the flask
expected_assertions: receiver lies farther right than in the source without changing size
delivery tube is longer and remains one continuous path
tube endpoint stays aligned above but does not enter or close the receiver opening
all other apparatus geometry matches the source
no annotation or decorative apparatus remains
